polityNote: United Republic of Tanzania (mainland regions and the Zanzibar regions). Atoms are the 170 districts of geoBoundaries TZA ADM2 (2021, NBS / OCHA, CC BY 3.0 IGO); every region is the union of its districts, and every district split 1972–2016 happened inside one region (statoids, GN 73), so the regions of each date are unions of today's districts: 2012 GN 72 moved whole districts (Bukombe, Chato, Geita, Busega, Bariadi, Maswa, Meatu, Mpanda, Ludewa, Makete, Njombe) and Songwe took Ileje, Mbozi, Momba, Tunduma and Songwe DC in 2016. The 2002 census reports 1967–1988 densities on the 2002 regions (Arusha/Manyara from 1988 only), consistent with unchanged region lines.
